posts.title: Notes on Lossy Systems
posts.description: Quick recap: In software engineering, a lossy system is what I call any system designed to return only incomplete answers. All sufficiently important systems are lossy. posts.title: Sitting Is Overrated
posts.description: Let’s stop pretending: Sitting is overrated. Everyone knows it’s bad for your spine, yet people keep doing it, almost as if there’s a society-wide conspiracy to make people sit on their ass for 8 hours and fiddle with spreadsheets all day.
